description: This source file defines extension methods for syntax manipulation and analysis within the Orleans code generation project, specifically focusing on symbol syntax extensions for Roslyn code analysis. It provides utilities for creating binding flag expressions and converting TypedConstant instances to expression syntax.

classes.name: SymbolSyntaxExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for syntax generation and analysis, including creating binding flag expressions and converting TypedConstant to C# syntax expressions.

methods.name: GetBindingFlagsParenthesizedExpressionSyntax
methods.description: Creates a parenthesized binary expression syntax node representing combined BindingFlags using the specified operation kind.

methods.name: ToExpression
methods.description: Converts a TypedConstant to an appropriate ExpressionSyntax, handling null, array, type, and enum kinds.

methods.name: DisplayEnumConstant
methods.description: Decodes an enum TypedConstant into an expression syntax, optionally combining multiple enum members with bitwise OR.

methods.name: ConvertToUInt64
methods.description: Converts various numeric types to a UInt64 for uniform processing.
